ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: the figure is a diagram of an insect life cycle. At the top there is a small circular stage, labeled C, resembling an egg; at the bottom there is a segmented worm-like stage, labeled A; on the left there is an adult beetle form, labeled D; on the right there is also an intermediate form, labeled B. Reasoning: the question asks what stage comes after egg. According to the life cycle of a mealworm/darkling beetle, after the egg hatches it enters the larval stage, and this larval stage is called mealworm. Therefore the answer is mealworm.
